description: A perforated black metal base plate sits on the bed with a small upright black bracket near its back edge, and a couple of loose screws lie nearby. The right hand lifts the bracket, sets it upright on the base plate, then pinches a screw and turns it with the fingertips against the bracket’s lower area, making small clockwise tightening motions while keeping the bracket steady; the bracket is a right-hand object during the placement, and the screw becomes a right-hand object during the finger‑twisting.
